name: Mahjong Majokko Taisen
original_name: マージャン 魔女ッ子大戦
source: In the magic country, Puff owns a mahjong club. One day the debt creditor fairy Bai who is also the teacher of Puff comes to the club asking for debt payment. Since Puff can not produce the payment, Bai instead asks Puff to collect magic potion materials from 8 magic girls around the country. In order to save her club, Puff sets off to challenge the magic girls. However, the materials are actually...
translation: 在魔法国度，泡芙拥有一家麻将俱乐部。有一天，债主白仙子，同时也是泡芙的老师，来到俱乐部讨债。由于泡芙无法出示付款，白转而要求泡芙向全国8位魔法少女收集魔法药剂材料。为了拯救俱乐部，帕芙出发向魔法少女们发起挑战。然而，材料实际上…
